description:
Checks the validity of your KLM/KPE (Knox Licence Manager) license.
This package is needed for Samsung Health (`com.sec.android.app.shealth`) and probably all Knox-related apps (like Secure Folder, Samsung Pay...)

Note: KLM licences are deprecated. Samsung now only supports KPE (Knox Platform for Enterprise) keys.
KPE keys are provided by Samsung and enable app's developers to access knox features.
